tools.name: daypass_status
tools.description: Show which Daypass leases are open, for which database, and how long is left.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables and views this lease can read (at least one column), with estimated row counts.

target.description: Which leased database to use. Needed only when daypass_status lists more than one lease.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Columns, types, nullability and indexes for one table (indexes touching hidden columns are omitted).

target.description: Which leased database to use. Needed only when daypass_status lists more than one lease.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run one read-only SELECT against the leased database. Hard limits: one statement, SELECT only, 10 s (or less if the lease is about to expire), up to the configured row cap (default 500 rows) and byte budget (default 1000000 bytes); results are cut in the database, not after. Some columns (PII, secrets) are hidden, so SELECT * fails on those tables: use describe_table and name columns. Use explain first on big tables.

target.description: Which leased database to use. Needed only when daypass_status lists more than one lease.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Show the query plan (EXPLAIN, never ANALYZE) for a SELECT so you can check its cost before running it.

sql.description: A single SELECT statement (without the EXPLAIN keyword)

target.description: Which leased database to use. Needed only when daypass_status lists more than one lease.
